public_rationale: There is evidence of generalization weaknesses and of data demand influencing consequential collection decisions. The evidence does not establish that the former drove the latter. limitations: Ethically consequential conduct is not automatically unlawful conduct.
The named examples and meaning of ethical choices are evaluator interpretations.
Developer decisions are documented through reputable reporting rather than accessible primary records.
